description: Kenya - Overview of Off-grid Electricity Service Areas is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Rhonda Jordan Antoine; Patrick Balla; Laurencia Njagi; Sudeshna Banerjee. (World Bank Group). This dataset represents the locations of existing mini-grids, mini-grids under development, proposed KOSAP mini-grids, and potential SHS markets in Kenya. This is the output of preliminary GIS analysis funded by the World Bank and undertaken in 2017. Coverage: Kenya. It has 8 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
